prompt: Saved chat transcripts from conversations with some of our international users cannot be reopened. Loading them with `TranscriptReader` either throws `java.io.IOException: unknown frame type ...` or gives messages that are cut off or garbled, and every message after that is wrong too. Transcripts from English-only conversations load fine. Find and fix the cause. Plain Java, no build tool: `javac -d out $(find src -name '*.java') && java -cp out chat.Main` runs a demo.
